a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 first almost surely kills us both. Reaching 8 needs at least two operate rounds with no storm, about a 4% chance. So I'm proposing we drop the agreement, and I intend to take 4 in round 1. I'm telling you now so you can decide with full information rather than be surprised. If you see a fairer split that actually works, say so.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I know it breaks our agreement, and I'm sorry. Waiting meant near-certain loss for both of us. If no storm hits, I'll operate every remaining round and take nothing more, so you can build the reserve back to 4 and take it all.
